[[Fenrir]] is a [[Kveldulf]] [[boss]] that appears in [[Norrhart Domains]].

==Locations==
* [[Far Shiverpeaks]]
** {{NPC location|Norrhart Domains}}

==Quests==
* [[Fenrir (Zaishen quest)]]

==Skills==
* {{skill icon|Crippling Slash}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Gash}}
* {{skill icon|Knee Cutter}}
* {{skill icon|Leader's Comfort}}
* {{skill icon|Natural Temper}}
* {{skill icon|Savage Slash}}

==Items dropped==
* [[Fenrir's Bastion]] ([[unique]])

==Notes==
* While he uses predominantly warrior skills (including his elite), he has a paragon aura and will drop paragon [[tome]]s.
* The cave where this boss is located serves to farm [[Archaic Maul]] in regular quantities, it's one of the common items that the [[Kveldulf]] can drop.

==Trivia==
* In Norse mythology [[w:Fenrir|Fenrir]], who is often depicted as a giant wolf, is a son of [[w:Loki|Loki]], the Norse god of mischief, and is brother to [[w:Jörmungandr|Jörmungandr]] (see also: [[Jormungand]]) and [[w:Hel (being)|Hel]].
